name: Ogre de la Caputxa Negra
depicted_variant: Black giant with completely covered hooded face lunges from his palace toward the road; palace key hangs at his neck.

visual_requirements.description: One black giant with face fully covered by black hood/cloth, one head/two arms/two legs, key around neck.
Road outside his palace; small gate and paving establish giant scale.

aura: Predatory giant scale c05, covered face c01/c04 and grasping pursuit action c01; no undocumented power effect.
artistic_choices: No power effect because claims describe kidnapping and sunlight weakness, no projectile or aura.
Black skin interpreted literally as supernatural charcoal-black ogre coloration c06, without human ethnic caricature; face stays completely covered as c01/c04.
Heavy opaque black cloak, iron key shape, night lighting and masonry design are editorial; key at neck c03 and palace c05 are sourced.
No child victims, treasure scene or princess depicted; road and grasping gesture convey predatory agency without violence.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of the Ogre de la Caputxa Negra, the giant black face-covered bogey of Valencian folklore who carries off children he finds on the road.
ANATOMY: ONE huge GIANT humanoid, ONE hooded head, TWO arms, TWO legs; supernatural charcoal-BLACK coarse skin on large hands, the ENTIRE FACE completely covered by dense opaque black cloth under a massive BLACK HOOD. No eyes, teeth or human face visible through covering. Fully opaque heavy black cloak and coarse dark garments from neck to feet. ONE large plain IRON PALACE KEY hangs visibly from a chain around his NECK in front of chest. [ogre-de-la-caputxa-negra-c01,ogre-de-la-caputxa-negra-c03,ogre-de-la-caputxa-negra-c04,ogre-de-la-caputxa-negra-c05,ogre-de-la-caputxa-negra-c06]
MOMENT: LUNGE one enormous step out from the shadow of his palace toward the road and low viewer, one giant five-fingered hand reaches to grasp directly toward camera, other hand braces against palace stone. Covered head bends toward us, hunting posture. No victims present.
POWER: no documented active power; menace through gigantic documented stature, covered faceless hood, grasping action and oppressive physical mass only. [ogre-de-la-caputxa-negra-c01,ogre-de-la-caputxa-negra-c05]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close view from road level; giant fills85% of square, small human-scale palace doors beside his shins establish unmistakable giant size; one key large and unobstructed at center chest.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant cold moon, strong edge light on hood, shoulders and charcoal-black hands; deep walnut-black shadows and a little ordinary road dust stirred by his step. NO SUNLIGHT reaches his covered face.
SURFACE: coarse charcoal skin, heavy weathered opaque black cloth, worn iron key, rough palace masonry and road stones; original painterly brushwork.
SETTING: road outside his dark palace in Valencian folklore, small gate and large wall behind. [ogre-de-la-caputxa-negra-c01,ogre-de-la-caputxa-negra-c05]
MOOD: terrifying faceless giant closing in to snatch viewer, never ordinary hooded traveller, decorative portrait, cute, calm or static.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no visible facial features, no invented horns/tusks/claws, no child or other victim, no human flesh or gore; no nudity; no text, letters, logo, frame, border, watermark, extra heads/limbs/fingers; no generic aura, glowing eyes, neon, energy ribbons, runes; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design.
